name: IBIT Short Volume Ratio — BTC Sentiment Indicator
description: Research study analyzing IBIT (iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF) short volume ratio as a Bitcoin sentiment indicator. Shows IBIT price over time, short volume ratio with 20-day moving average overlay, and summary statistics (avg, current, max, min short volume ratio).
source:
# =============================================================================
# IBIT SHORT VOLUME RATIO — BTC SENTIMENT INDICATOR
# =============================================================================
# Analyzes IBIT short volume ratio as a proxy for Bitcoin sentiment.
# Reports: price chart, short vol ratio with 20-day MA, summary stats.
# Note: short_volume_ratio is in percentage units (0-100).
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# SHORT VOLUME DATA
# =============================================================================

sv_data = short_volume()()
sv_ratio = sv_data.short_volume_ratio   # percentage units (0-100)
sv_ratio_ma = sma(period=20)(sv_ratio)  # 20-day moving average

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# Chart 1: IBIT Price
xy_lines(
    title='IBIT Price',
    category='BTC Sentiment',
    y_axis_label='Price ($)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.MonetaryFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='IBIT Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=close)

# Chart 2: Short Volume Ratio with 20-day MA overlay
xy_lines(
    title='Short Volume Ratio — IBIT (BTC Proxy)',
    category='BTC Sentiment',
    y_axis_label='Short Volume Ratio (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Short Vol Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=50, title='50%', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(sv_ratio, sv_ratio_ma))

# Summary table: avg, current (last), max, min short volume ratio
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='IBIT Short Volume Ratio Summary',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Short Vol Ratio (%)'],
        col_headers=['Average', 'Current', 'Max', 'Min'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='BTC Sentiment',
    order=2
)(sv_ratio, sv_ratio, sv_ratio, sv_ratio)
